Who are we?

We are South Europe Technologies (SET Iberia); the IT, Data and Operations Shared Service Center of BNP Paribas Personal Finance, with delivery centers in Spain and Portugal, providing the best solutions to BNPP PF entities around the world such as Cetelem (specialized, between others, in financial partnership of major retailers, consumer goods companies and car dealerships).

Among Other Services, Our Portfolio Is Composed Of:

Applications Management (Architecture, Project Management, Development, and Quality Assurance).
IT Risks & Cybersecurity Services.
Platforms Management.
Data Analytics and AI.
Operations.

Our offices are in Spain (Madrid) and Portugal (Lisbon, Porto). The company brings together over 200+ employees, with expertise in various technologies (Java, .Net, Python, Tibco, APIGee) and other operational roles (Functional Analyst, Project Manager, Business Analyst, Auto Stock Financing operators). We keep growing!

Our consistent track record of services delivery means comfort for our customers and opportunities for our employees.

You will find SE.T to be full of energy and an Inclusive Workplace in which you truly can make a difference.

Would you like to join our international team that delivers end-to-end solutions (applications and operations activities) to businesses of BNP Paribas Personal Finance Group entities around the world?

In a context, we are looking for a Developer to perform tasks of coding, testing and documentation of software applications. Therefore, it will carry out the software codification based on functional requirements and organix designs, unit testing and the documentation of processes/developments to ensure the correct maintenance of the solution and possible future evolutions.

Main responsibilities:

Programming.
Tests.
Resolution of incidents in production.
Participation in Agile ceremonies.
Proactive communication with the Functional Analysts team and Technical leads.

IT Tools

PowerBuilder (12.5 or higher).
PL/SQL Oracle (11g or higher) / SQL Developer.
GIT.
Service Now, Confluence, Teams.

Very Nice To Have

Knowledge of AI applied to software development.
Knowledge of testing tools, such us UFT.
Knowledge of modelling schemes, such as UML.

Skills

BUSINESS

Knowledge of banking and banking processes will be an asset.
Business logic knowledge and IT Relations.

Transversal Skills

Experience in Agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban).

Behavioral Skills

Ability to understand, explain, and support solution evolutions.
Ability to meet objectives / Result orientation.
With attention to detail/ Rigorous.
Collaboration and teamwork.
Problem/incident resolution.
Client focused.
Effective communication and problem-solving skills.
Proactivity.

LANGUAGES

English level B1 or higher.

Benefits:

Training programs, career plans and internal mobility opportunities, national and international thanks to our presence in different countries.
Diversity and Inclusion Committee that ensures an inclusive work environment. In recent years, several employee communities have been created to organize diversity and inclusion awareness actions (PRIDE, We Generations and MixCity).
Corporate volunteering program (1 Million Hours 2 Help) in which employees can dedicate time out of their working hours to volunteer activities.
Flexible compensation plan
Hybrid telecommuting model (50%)
31 vacation days.

Diversity and Inclusion commitment

BNP Paribas Group in Spain is an equal opportunity employer and proud to provide equal employment opportunity to all job seekers. We are actively committed to ensuring that no individual is discriminated against on the grounds of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage or civil partnership status, pregnancy and maternity/paternity, race, religion or belief, sex or sexual orientation. Equity and diversity are at the core of our recruitment policy because we believe that they foster creativity and efficiency, which in turn increase performance and productivity. We strive to reflect the society we live in, while keeping with the image of our clients.

About Our Culture

We are proud to create, maintain, and develop strategic business applications for BNP Paribas Personal Finance entities worldwide, maintaining high service levels and delivering added value to our customers. In our multicultural environment, we encourage all team members to develop their talents and skills, providing a wide variety of career opportunities and internal mobility programs within local SET teams or across other entities in the Group, both in Spain and globally.

We value the experience of our employees and work to maintain a balanced environment, offering flexibility regarding work schedules and respect for personal time. Our hybrid working model is a testament to our belief that social connection enhances our daily activities.

BNP Paribas Personal Finance es un actor clave en el crédito al consumo en España y Europa, ofreciendo una amplia gama de productos de financiación para particulares.

Filial al 100 % del Grupo BNP Paribas, la compañía proporciona, a través de sus marcas Cetelem, Findomestic y Alpha Credit, una completa gama de productos de crédito como préstamos personales, tarjetas y préstamos al consumo disponibles en tiendas, concesionarios de automóviles, y directamente para los clientes en los centros de contacto y online. Desde 2023, a través de su marca Cetelem, ofrece también en España productos de pasivo como cuentas corrientes, tarjetas de débito, cuentas de ahorro y depósitos.

En 2024, BNP Paribas Personal Finance generó 4 900 millones de euros en ingresos, atendió a 22 millones de clientes y empleó a cerca de 17 000 personas.

Desde hace muchos años, BNP Paribas Personal Finance desarrolla una estrategia activa de soporte a socios comerciales como marcas de distribución, fabricantes y distribuidores de automóviles, sitios de comercio electrónico y otras instituciones financieras (bancos y aseguradoras). Estas colaboraciones a largo plazo se apoyan en su profundo conocimiento del mercado y en su capacidad para ofrecer servicios integrados adaptados a las operaciones y estrategias comerciales de sus socios, con alianzas clave como Apple, Jaguar Land Rover, Grupo Hyundai Motor, Más Orange, así como Bank of Nanjing y Geely en China.

Para apoyar a sus clientes y socios, BNP Paribas Personal Finance está comprometida con promover el acceso a un consumo más responsable y sostenible.

Para más información, visítanos en www.bnpparibas-pf.es
Compromisos
Desarrollo y formación profesional
From the moment you join BNP Paribas Personal Finance, you’ll be supported in expanding your soft and hard skills. We give you the opportunity to train and to adapt to changes and developments in your job but also to develop your expertise and benefit from numerous internal career opportunities. You will work in a stimulating international environment where the culture of developing new skills is encouraged. Throughout your internal career we make maintaining your employability a priority. 

Diversidad, igualdad e inclusión
For several years, BNP Paribas Personal Finance has been pursuing a proactive policy to promote diversity and inclusion in order to combat all forms of discrimination and guarantee a sustainable working environment. Making our compny an inclusive place is everyone's job at every turn. Our Diversity & Inclusion Charter aims to provide an overall vision of the Diversity & Inclusion policy, to make as many people as possible aware of the five commitments that will be implemented by the company by 2025 and to share with our countries the main ambitions of our Diversity & Inclusion policy in order to help them build their action plan.

Sostenibilidad
At BNP Paribas Personal Finance, our conviction is that consumption is at the core of these global challenges, and that it can also provide a key answer to them. Through more responsible consumption, people have the power to preserve natural resources, reduce their carbon footprint and make a difference on a greater scale. Our purpose: "Promote access to more responsible and sustainable consumption, to support our customers and our partners", embodies BNP Paribas Personal Finance’s ambition to place positive impact at the heart of our business on the same level of our economic performance.

Conciliación laboral
We care about striking the right work/life balance. That is why we also give our employees the option of hybrid working, (with a choice of several office/home-working rhythm options).
